I’m comparing three approaches: release roadblock #4 earlier, remove or intercept the nearby officers sooner, or change the lower holder to provide both blocking and roadblock damage. Each can affect healer allocation and artillery survival, so I’ll record those as regression risks and test all outcomes in the same run.

The candidate will replace lower-lane Spot with Melantha at the same tile and frame. Her forward attack range is intended to clear roadblock #4 before #14 arrives, then kill the lower officers. Fang, Friston, Midnight, both physicians, and Steward keep their R106 opening deployments. Midnight’s second skill moves from 5400 to 5073 to provide arts damage during the central pressure.

The main risk is losing Spot’s healing and three-block capacity. That can change heal recipients and threaten both #11/#13 closure and Steward’s artillery output. The validation card below records these dependencies; none is assumed to succeed.

Initial effective costs10+3+16+15+17+17+18=96 DP, two less than R10698; natural DP1/s, initial10, Fang automatic+6 per ready cycle. No earlier spend than parent, no death refund assumed. Same Steward redeploy costs and three70s gaps, same Midnight70s gap. Melantha initialSP0/cost40/duration20s:901->2102 is1201frames, next skills1801apart; Midnight1772->5073 is1200active+2101inactive, next8374 likewise.
